tpl: Lifts off immediately upon deployment, attack range expanded, ATK +{0}, and attacks 2 targets at once

Expands her attack range and glides forward into Lift Off, Levitating ground enemies within the swept range for {0} seconds and binding flying enemies to the ground for {1} seconds. Afterwards, attack interval is reduced, ATK +{2}, and attacks become Arts damage hitting {3} targets at once

Expands her attack range and glides forward into Lift Off, Levitating ground enemies within the swept range for 12 seconds and binding flying enemies to the ground for 22 seconds. Afterwards, attack interval is greatly reduced, ATK +{0}, and attacks become Arts damage hitting 5 targets at once

Lifts off immediately, ATK +{0}, gains {1} Anti-Air Shelter, attack range expanded, and the surrounding 8 tiles also count as her attack range. Attacks deal {2} of ATK as Physical damage to 3 enemies and additionally strike 1 flying enemy. Flying enemies in range have Movement Speed {3}. If an unblocked, blockable flying enemy is within the original skill range while she is not blocking, she moves to that enemy's tile. The attack carries {4} rounds of ammunition; the skill ends when they run out (it can be stopped manually at any time)
